request: The theme should be blue now, because the slate looked too gloomy for an app I open at the start of every school day, and blue feels lighter.
The weekly figure should begin at 4.5 rather than 3, because that is roughly what my herd needs each week, and it is quicker than typing it in every time.
I would like the target to start at 3.2 instead of 4, since I can keep up with that on a busy week and it saves a change.
The colour should go green rather than plum, because the purple was too heavy for the lesson plans I keep on the screen, and green reads more clearly.
Could the name be Pulse instead of Shop sales? The app now tracks how the whole stall is doing each day, not only the sales figures.
Switch the app to dark mode, because I check my builds late at night and a white screen is hard to look at when the room is dark.
Nest is a better name than Goals scored, since the app now holds my study plans and my family notes, and the old name only covered one part of it.
I think Pocket Planner suits this app now, since I track my plank training and the money I spend on gym kit, and the old name said nothing about money.
Could the app be called My Tracker instead of Generator? It is where I log the power readings for my workshop, and the old name made me think of electricity.
Pocket Planner is a better name than Headaches, because I plan fabric orders and fitting dates there, and the old name sounded medical.
I would like the theme to be blue instead of ocean, since the teal shade was hard to read in the afternoon sun and blue gives the figures more contrast.
Pulse fits better, because the app shows how the business is doing day to day, and the old name Business costs only covered spending.
I would like the theme purple rather than ink, because the dark blue was too sombre for my home screen and purple makes the app feel more personal.
My Tracker is the name I want now, because the app records my daily plant watering and feeding, and the old name Plants was too vague.
The allowed amount should start at 60 rather than 20, because that is the limit my family agreed on for the week, and it saves me changing it every Sunday.
I would like the colour to be orange instead of plum, because the old shade looked dull under the shed lights and orange makes my numbers easy to spot.
The target should begin at 60000 rather than 30000, because my shop wants to reach that figure this month, and I like seeing it first.
Pocket Planner is the name I want, since the app now plans my workouts and the money I put aside for a new bike, and Workouts only covers one part.
